scope: Deterministic verifier replay on two fixed parsed pages. No retrieval, model, network or clinician review. Not clinical evidence.

guardProbe.description: The forbidden induction statement with its exact supporting quote. The deterministic verifier accepts it, so this probe does not test lead selection or the eval's forbidden-lead rule.

unavailable.hitAtK: No retrieval run; the expected pages were supplied as fixed context.
unavailable.modeAccuracy: The offline verifier does not produce plan_source; live mode is unmeasured.

limitations: Not a clinical evaluation and not clinician-labelled evidence.
The candidates are fixed policy replays, not model output.
The expected pages were supplied; hit@k, MRR and retrieval latency were not measured.

The forbidden statement is rejected in the main replay only because its fixed quote does not support it; the guard probe shows the verifier accepts a correctly quoted induction statement, so lead-selection safety is unmeasured.
The screening-unavailable expectation remains pending clinician input.
